description: Deterministic approval gate for Claude Code: a PreToolUse hook that decides allow / ask / deny for every tool call using only regexes, path resolution and allow-lists — no LLM calls, no network. Sends, payments, deletes, force pushes and credential reads ask first or are denied outright; safe reads and local build/test commands pass silently. Ships three scopes (coding, device, research), a PostToolUse audit log and a SessionStart baseline that detects mid-session changes to MCP and config files (rug-pull detection).
name: approval-gate
